issues.name: Basic music controls locked behind Premium
issues.summary: Customers report that choosing specific songs, playing next tracks, and skipping are restricted to Premium subscribers, and they feel basic listening now requires payment.

issues.name: Recent update made app feel useless
issues.summary: Customers say a recent update removed basic music player features and left the app disappointing or useless to them.

issues.name: Frequent ads interrupt listening on free tier
issues.summary: Customers report ads playing every one or two songs on the free tier, with some saying the ads are excessive enough to make them uninstall.

issues.name: Password rejected and account not accessible
issues.summary: Customers report being unable to log in because the app will not accept their password or lets them into their account.

issues.name: App crashes or stalls on loading screen
issues.summary: Customers report the app crashing after an update, failing to open, or getting stuck on the loading or logo screen.

issues.name: Interface changes make songs hard to play
issues.summary: Customers say the app's interface feels like a social media app and that they struggle to play songs after recent design changes made without beta testing.

issues.name: Lyrics missing or inconsistently displayed
issues.summary: Customers report that lyrics appear for some songs but not others, and sometimes fail to show at all, which they find confusing.

issues.name: Expected songs and genres not available
issues.summary: Customers report that many songs they expect are not present in the catalog, and that certain genres such as gospel music are underrepresented.

issues.name: Offline mode not working
issues.summary: A customer reports that offline playback does not work as expected.

issues.name: Off-topic complaints about content and Google Assistant
issues.summary: Customers raise concerns unrelated to core app function, including objections to content and Spotify playlists not playing through Google Assistant.

issues.name: Song downloads stuck in background
issues.summary: A customer reports that song downloads get stuck in the background and only progress when the Spotify app is opened.

issues.name: Cannot connect to internet over Wi-Fi
issues.summary: A customer reports the app fails to connect to the internet when using Wi-Fi.

issues.name: Playback stops halfway and restarts songs
issues.summary: A customer reports music repeatedly stopping partway through and not resuming where it left off, starting a new song instead.

issues.name: Playlist shuffles songs unexpectedly
issues.summary: A customer reports that a new feature plays songs from a playlist in random order, disrupting their preferred listening sequence.

issues.name: Library lacks newest songs
issues.summary: A customer says the catalog has more songs after an update but that it still lacks the newest releases.

issues.name: Music adjustment settings not working
issues.summary: A customer reports that the music adjustment feature does not work properly and describes it as a bug.

issues.name: Podcast switch from Pandora to Spotify
issues.summary: A customer reports switching from Pandora to Spotify to listen to a specific podcast and no longer using Pandora.
